name: What permits are required to build a tiny home in San Marcos?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required to build a tiny home in San Marcos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a tiny home in San Marcos, whether on a foundation or as a movable unit, generally requires permits from the city's planning and building departments. If it's an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), you'll need ADU permits covering zoning, structural, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical aspects. Even tiny homes on wheels used as permanent residences may require specific permits or placement regulations. Zen Tiny Homes assists clients in navigating the local permitting process specific to San Marcos regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny homes in San Marcos require permits from city planning and building departments, especially if an ADU, covering zoning, structural, and utility aspects.
